VIPLOVE GUPTA Functional Business Analyst – Liquidity / ALM / Banking Transformation

Email: viplovepallavi@gmail.com | Phone: +91-9336139413 | Location: India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Functional Business Analyst and banking implementation professional with 13+ years of experience across BFSI, banking finance, risk management, Asset Liability Management (ALM), Liquidity Management, Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Profitability and Funds Transfer Pricing (PFT), regulatory reporting and loan management systems. Experienced across requirements gathering, functional analysis, design documentation, data understanding, configuration support, SIT, UAT, defect management, Go-Live and production support. Strong understanding of banking products, balance sheet management, funding and liquidity processes, financial analysis, reporting and profitability. Hands-on experience with Oracle Financial Services Analytical Applications (OFSAA) and ALM implementations for domestic and international banking clients.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• • • • • • • Data Understanding, Source-to-Target Mapping and Interface Impact Analysis • PCC-to-LMS Migration / Integration, Data Migration & Validation • SIT, UAT, Test Strategy, Test Cases, Defect Triage and Regression Testing • Go-Live, Production Support, Change Requests and Operational Readiness • • Oracle OFSAA, Kastle ALM, PL/SQL Developer, QC/ALM, MS Office and Power BI DOMAIN EXPERTISE – LIQUIDITY / ALM

Functional Business Analysis and Requirements Elicitation Liquidity Management and Asset Liability Management (ALM) Balance Sheet Analysis and Interest Rate Risk Management Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and Profitability Management (PFT) Banking Finance, Risk Management and Regulatory Reporting BRD / FRD / FSD / SMD Documentation and Traceability Functional Gap Analysis, Process Mapping and Solution Support

Stakeholder Management, Workshops and Business-Technology Coordination

• • •



•

Asset Liability Management (ALM), liquidity management and banking risk management processes. Balance sheet analysis, cash flow and financial statement analysis, funding structures and liquidity positions. Interest Rate Risk Management, repricing analysis, maturity analysis and interest rate sensitivity reporting. Liquidity risk management concepts, including liquidity measurement, monitoring, cash flow projections and maturity mismatches. Exposure to Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), liquidity risk reporting and related regulatory concepts. ALCO reporting, structural liquidity statements, behavioural analysis, rate shock and option-adjusted gap analysis. Functional requirements gathering, design documentation, configuration support, testing, defect resolution and implementation support.

FUNCTIONAL BA & DELIVERY CAPABILITIES

Conducting stakeholder discussions and workshops to understand current processes, business needs and functional gaps. • Preparing and reviewing BRD, FRD, FSD and SMD documentation; translating business requirements into functional specifications.

Migration planning, lower-to-higher environment deployment, data validation and migration testing • Defining functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria for business validation where applicable. • Understanding source-system data, supporting source-to-target mapping, validating data elements and assessing upstream/downstream dependencies. Preparing test strategies, test plans, scenarios and detailed test cases; coordinating SIT and UAT execution. Analysing defects, participating in defect triage, coordinating resolution with technical teams, and performing retesting and regression testing. Supporting business users, obtaining sign-off, coordinating Go-Live and providing post-production implementation support.

•



•

Acting as the bridge between Treasury/ALM, Finance, Risk, Operations, Business, Technology, QA and Project Management teams.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

TIAA Global Capabilities | Senior Associate / Application Owner – OFSAA | Jun 2022 – Present



Application Owner for OFSAA modules including Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Profitability and Funds Transfer Pricing (PFT), and RoRWA.

Manage change requests, daily processes, business issues, functional analysis and code analysis. • Coordinate the end-to-end implementation lifecycle including requirements, documentation, SIT, UAT, Go-Live and production support.

Conduct requirement gathering, estimation, impact assessment, change tracking and functional documentation. • Work with business, technology and testing teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues and support successful delivery. • Support data validation, business rule validation, defect resolution and implementation of changes across banking finance and risk management systems.

KPMG Advisory | Business Analyst | Jul 2021 – Jun 2022

• • • Coordinated with business and technical stakeholders for requirement clarification, issue resolution and delivery tracking. Clover Infotech | Business Analyst / Application Owner | Aug 2020 – Jul 2021

Supported regulatory reporting initiatives for ICICI Bank, including daily and monthly management reporting. Performed business requirement analysis, functional gap analysis and preparation of FSD/SMD documentation. Supported change request implementation, functional testing, SIT, UAT and deployment activities.

Worked as application owner for regulatory reporting modules. • Performed business requirement gathering, functional analysis and test planning. • Prepared functional documentation, test scenarios and test cases, and supported SIT/UAT execution. • Coordinated with development and QA teams for defect analysis, resolution and implementation support. 3i Infotech Ltd | Business Analyst & Implementation Expert | Mar 2014 – Feb 2019

Delivered ALM implementations for major BFSI clients across India and Nigeria. • • Worked on requirements gathering, functional analysis, design documentation, configuration support, development coordination, SIT, UAT and Go-Live. Supported structural liquidity statements, behavioural analysis, rate shock and option-adjusted gap analysis.

Supported liquidity management, ALCO and interest rate sensitivity reporting.

• Worked with regulatory and reporting requirements including NHB and CBN guidelines. •

Supported banking platform implementation and transformation activities by understanding legacy processes and translating them into target-system functionality. Worked on a Universal Lending System, comprising LMS (Loan Management System) and LO (Loan Origination), supporting migration and deployment of application components from lower to higher environments. Supported PCC-to-LMS data migration/integration activities, involving analysis and validation of payment transactions, customer accounts, cash balances, securities/custody balances, and incoming/outgoing cash flows. Supported translation and validation of migrated data for downstream liquidity forecasting, cash-flow analysis, funding management, liquidity position monitoring, maturity analysis and regulatory liquidity reporting. Performed functional impact analysis, data validation, source-to-target mapping and coordination with technology/QA teams during migration, testing and implementation activities.







SELECTED PROJECT EXPERIENCE

SBI Bank, Mumbai | Application Owner – OFSAA FTP / PFT / RoRWA | Aug 2021 – Present

• • Daily process management, change request tracking, system testing and issue resolution. • Coordination with business, technology and QA stakeholders across the implementation lifecycle. ICICI Bank, Hyderabad | Application Owner – Regulatory Reporting | Aug 2020 – Jul 2021

Requirement gathering, functional analysis, code analysis and FSD/SMD documentation. SIT, UAT, Go-Live and change implementation support.

• • Daily and monthly regulatory reporting support.

Business requirement analysis and preparation of FSD/SMD documentation.

• •

SIT, UAT, Go-Live and change implementation support. Functional testing, stakeholder coordination and issue resolution.

PNBHFL, New Delhi | Business Analyst & Implementation Expert – Kastle ALM | Mar 2015 – Feb 2019

• Delivered interest rate sensitivity and behavioural analysis-based reporting. • • •

ALM implementation supporting structural liquidity statements aligned to NHB guidelines.

Performed requirements gathering, functional analysis, code analysis and development coordination. Supported SIT, UAT, Go-Live and change management activities. Received appreciation for implementing the ALM module within timelines.

Bank of Industries, Nigeria | Business Analyst & Implementation Expert – Kastle ALM | Jun 2016 – Dec 2016

Supported ALM implementation for an international banking client in Nigeria. • Delivered liquidity and interest rate sensitivity reports aligned to CBN guidelines. • Worked on rate shock and option-adjusted gap analysis modules. • • PLATFORMS & TOOLS

Performed requirement analysis, documentation, SIT/UAT, Go-Live and change management.

Received appreciation for successful ALM implementation.

Oracle Financial Services Analytical Applications (OFSAA) • OFSAA Asset Liability Management (ALM) • • • • • • QC/ALM for test management • Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint • INTERNATIONAL & REGIONAL EXPOSURE

Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) Profitability and Funds Transfer Pricing (PFT) Regulatory Reporting and Risk Management modules Kastle ALM PL/SQL Developer

Power BI – Basic knowledge

• Worked with client and business stakeholders on requirements, functional analysis, implementation, configuration support, testing, documentation, Go-Live and production support. Exposure to differing banking processes, regulatory expectations, stakeholder requirements and international delivery models.

International banking implementation exposure across Lagos/Nigeria and Dubai/UAE.



PROFESSIONAL HIGHLIGHTS

• •

Appreciation from PNBHFL for implementing the ALM module within timelines. Appreciation from Bank of Industries, Nigeria, for successful ALM implementation. Experience across the complete implementation lifecycle: requirements, design, configuration support, SIT, UAT, Go-Live and production support.
